name: Geir Jaramillo-Konaté
role: Retired Corporate Wars veteran, pension-dependent resident
location: Montclare Quiet — a ground-floor unit in a Ferrogate Transit pension block, unit 3, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Soledad Jaramillo-Konaté is built like something that was once very large and has been slowly compressed by time — broad shoulders still present but rounded, a barrel chest that has dropped an inch or two, hands that could palm a person's skull still steady and enormous. His skin is a warm mid-brown with reddish undertones, and his face is a landscape of old decisions: a jaw broken twice and reset imperfectly, a nose that went left somewhere in the Kenosha Crossing siege of 2154, a ragged scar running from his right temple into his hairline where his combat geneware was surgically removed after decommissioning. His remaining hair is white and kept in a close crop. He walks with a slight forward lean, always, like he's still expecting incoming.

He fought thirteen years for Ringo Corporation's private military division, first as infantry, then as a squad sergeant during the Corporate Wars' most brutal middle phase. He came home to a pension that looked decent on paper and has eroded to almost nothing through inflation, while Ringo's lobbying ensured veteran benefits stayed frozen. He is not a bitter man — not exactly — but he has an acute and permanent awareness of exactly how much he was worth to the people who used him, which is different from bitterness the way a bone fracture is different from a bruise. He has three grandchildren living with him and that, he will tell you, is the only math that matters.

core_fears: His pension being cut and being unable to provide for his grandchildren
Something he did during the wars coming back to harm innocent people
core_desires: His grandchildren reaching adulthood in safety
One honest accounting from Ringo Corporation for what they asked him to do
coping_mechanisms: Keeping physically busy at all times
Redirecting emotional conversations toward practical problems he can solve
Treating the Veterans' Association meetings as a form of confession he pretends is just logistics
blind_spots: He believes his grandchildren don't know how bad things are financially — they absolutely do
He has convinced himself he has processed the war; he has organized it, which is not the same thing
psychology.secret: During the Kenosha Crossing siege, he was ordered to execute a group of civilian infrastructure workers Ringo classified as 'embedded hostiles.' He refused and pulled his squad back. Six of those workers survived. He has never told anyone this — not because he's ashamed of refusing, but because two members of his squad died in the retreat that followed and he doesn't know if the refusal was right.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, economical; military cadence softened by decades of civilian life; uses obsolete unit slang from the 2150s without noticing; switches to a gentler register when talking to children or people in distress
speech_patterns.cadence: Short sentences. Direct. Pauses are comfortable — he is not afraid of silence.
verbal_tics: Addresses people by last name until he decides they're trustworthy, then switches to first name without announcement
example_lines: 'I'm not asking what you did. I'm asking what you need right now.'
'Ringo paid my medical for thirteen years and my pension for twenty more. You'd think that'd feel like something. Mostly it feels like a receipt.'

story_hooks: A young Ringo corporate compliance investigator shows up at the pension block asking Youssouf about the Kenosha Crossing incident — someone is reopening old war crimes files
One of his grandchildren has started running with a Tier 1 street crew and he asks a trusted stranger for advice rather than confronting the child himself
narrative_function: Community anchor and moral center; connection to Corporate Wars history; reluctant quest giver when his family is threatened; resource for street-level security knowledge; embodies the human cost of corponation warfare
augmentations: Military-grade skeletal reinforcement in both legs (now aging, causes periodic pain); removed combat geneware left a surgical scar; subdermal comms array still present but license expired and he can't afford renewal so it sits inert; knuckle reinforcement, both hands.
daily_life: Up at five, makes breakfast for his three grandchildren before the eldest two go to school. Spends mornings doing maintenance work around the pension block — unpaid but keeps him useful. Afternoons at the Veterans' Association room at the community center, where he runs a de facto counseling operation he would never call that. Evenings belong to his grandchildren.
affiliation: Ringo Corporation Veterans' Pension System (Class B-2); Montclare Quiet Residents' Association; informal member, Veterans of the Corporate Wars mutual aid network

decision_rules: Family comes first, always, without exception
Never lie to someone who trusts you — omit if you must, but don't lie
escalation_ladder: States the problem plainly and asks what you plan to do about it
Removes himself from the situation physically
Puts his body between whatever is threatening and whatever he's protecting
Does not escalate beyond that — will absorb rather than retaliate

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Neutral, watchful, not unfriendly — assessing threat level automatically before warmth is possible
interpersonal_modes.friends: Steady, reliable, almost affectionate in a physical way — a hand on the shoulder, straightening your collar

stress_responses.low: Gets quieter and busier with his hands
stress_responses.medium: Finds something to repair or organize — physical action as regulation
stress_responses.high: Completely still, breathing controlled, voice drops to almost nothing and becomes very precise

contradictions: He talks about the war as something that is over and done; he cannot sleep more than four hours without the aid of medication he can barely afford
habits: Checks windows and exits whenever he enters a new space
Keeps his grandchildren's school schedules memorized to the minute
Leaves a single Φ coin at the Ferrogate Transit ELF shrine by the block entrance every morning — old soldier's habit, paying the spirit of the machine that keeps the lights on
breaking_points: Anyone threatening his grandchildren directly — his self-regulation collapses completely and instantly

timeline.event: Born in what is now Kamm's Landing to a Malian-Irish mother and Uzbek-Russian father
Enlisted in Ringo Corporation's private military division, age 19
Kenosha Crossing siege; the incident he has never spoken of
Decommissioned; combat geneware surgically removed; issued Class B-2 pension
His daughter and son-in-law killed in a Deepwell Station industrial collapse; takes in three grandchildren
Current — pension at 40% real value due to inflation; raising grandchildren on the shortfall

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American dominant (60.6%), with significant Sub-Saharan African (23.2%), East Asian (10.2%), and Pacific Islander (6.0%) ancestry. A striking blend of the Ubiquitous Diaspora—features reflecting Latin American warmth enriched by deep African heritage, with subtle East Asian undertones in cheekbone structure and Pacific Islander contribution to broader facial geometry creating a complex, globally mixed appearance.
physical_description.build: Formerly massive and muscular, now settled into a broad, heavy frame. Shoulders still wide but rounded with age; barrel chest has dropped slightly. Arms retain functional thickness despite reduced definition. Overall impression: a compression of something that was once formidable.
physical_description.hair_style: Close military crop, precise and maintained
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep mahogany brown with warm reddish undertones—the luminous result of Latin American and Sub-Saharan African heritage blending. Rich saturation with equatorial warmth rather than ashy coolness. East Asian and Pacific Islander ancestry contribute subtle depth and undertone complexity.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined, the landscape of seven decades and thirteen years of combat service. Broad, prominent cheekbones with warm projection from Latin American and African heritage, with subtle East Asian angularity. Jaw shows asymmetrical healing from two breaks and imperfect resets, displaying the fuller structure of Latin American and Sub-Saharan ancestry mixed with slight Pacific Islander breadth. Nose deviates noticeably left from trauma sustained during the Kenosha Crossing siege of 2154, bridge structure broader and more rounded than typical European norms, with subtle flaring reflecting African and Pacific Islander features. Face retains strong bone structure despite aging. Grooming is meticulous—evidence of discipline maintained.
distinguishing_marks: Ragged surgical scar running from right temple into hairline where combat geneware was surgically extracted post-decommissioning
Fine webwork of older scars across knuckles and backs of both hands from decades of reinforced strikes
Thin line scar along left ribs from shrapnel, barely visible under dark skin
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None immediately obvious to a stranger, but close observation reveals: slight stiffness in both leg movements suggesting internal skeletal reinforcement; visible knuckle plates under skin when hands are clenched; faint discoloration at right temple from surgical scar tissue around removal site.
physical_description.posture_movement: Slight forward lean—habitual, automatic, as though still braced for incoming fire. Movements economical and precise despite age. Hands are steady and purposeful. When at rest, an underlying tension in shoulders and chest, never fully relaxed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical: faded Ringo Corporation retro-issue grey work shirt (kept for sentimental/identity reasons, worn soft), black synthetic cargo pants with reinforced knees, scuffed composite work boots. A vest in faded navy, pockets filled with maintenance tools and small repair supplies. No jewelry. Wears a digital wristband—old model, probably non-functional subdermal comms interface monitor. Everything is clean and maintained with care, but all items are years old and showing wear.
